items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the vehicle and traffic law, in relation to prohibiting the imposition of any additional fee for a veteran's notation on a non-driver identification card or a driver's license

A.actClause: AN ACT to amend the vehicle and traffic law, in relation to prohibiting the imposition of any additional fee for a veteran's distinguishing mark on a non-driver identification card or a driver's license

summary: Prohibits the imposition of any additional fee for the issuance of a driver's license or non-driver identification card with a veteran's distinguishing mark.
